name: aerospike_backup_service_backup_duration_seconds
description: Duration in seconds of finished backups by routine and type (full/incremental)

name: aerospike_backup_service_backup_events_total
description: Total completed backup runs by routine, type, and outcome (success, failure, canceled, retry, skip)

name: aerospike_backup_service_backup_progress_ratio
description: Progress of backup processes as a ratio (0.0 to 1.0)

name: aerospike_backup_service_backups_active
description: Number of backups currently running for the given routine and backup type (full/incremental)

name: aerospike_backup_service_last_successful_backup_timestamp_seconds
description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the last successful backup per routine

name: aerospike_backup_service_restores_total
description: Total completed restore jobs by outcome (success, failure, canceled)

name: aerospike_backup_service_backup_progress_pct
description: Progress of backup processes in percentage (Deprecated: use aerospike_backup_service_backup_progress_ratio instead.)

name: aerospike_backup_service_last_successful_backup_timestamp
description: Unix timestamp of the last successful backup per routine (Deprecated: use aerospike_backup_service_last_successful_backup_timestamp_seconds instead.)

name: aerospike_backup_service_restore_in_progress
description: Number of restore processes running (Deprecated: use aerospike_backup_service_restores_active instead.)
